subject.title: docs(install): add vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide

question: After the NVIDIA setup guidance is repaired, should OpenClaw accept a vendor-neutral Jetson install guide in first-party docs, or should Jetson and turnkey hardware guidance live outside core docs?
rationale: The linked issue explicitly asks for policy on hardware documentation, and VISION.md routes optional promotion and commercial ecosystem surfaces away from core while current docs already have a Raspberry Pi precedent.

options.title: Accept Vendor-Neutral Guide After Repair
options.body: Keep a first-party Jetson install page if it stays source-backed, generic, and avoids commercial turnkey hardware promotion.

options.title: Route Hardware Guidance Outside Core
options.body: Close or pause the PR and ask contributors to maintain Jetson or appliance setup in vendor/ecosystem docs or ClawHub-adjacent surfaces.

options.title: Narrow To Generic ARM Host Docs
options.body: Replace the Jetson-specific guide with broader small-Linux-device guidance if maintainers do not want a first-party NVIDIA hardware page.

recommendation.title: Accept Vendor-Neutral Guide After Repair
recommendation.body: Keep a first-party Jetson install page if it stays source-backed, generic, and avoids commercial turnkey hardware promotion.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is product/docs boundary policy rather than code ownership, and Peter appears in recent docs policy/navigation history.
